title: The secret behind Ken Masters' fall in Street Fighter 6
subject: ken
description:
Would you have trusted JP? 👇

How JP turned Ken Masters' own money against him before Street Fighter 6. Spoilers for Street Fighter 6 and its prequel comic Days of the Eclipse.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The tournament Ken Masters paid for was secretly funding terrorists.
Ken's Masters Foundation poured money into Nayshall, working alongside a charming businessman named JP.
JP was secretly leading Amnesia, a terror group built by former Shadaloo agents.
Every check Ken signed was quietly feeding the enemy he never saw coming.
But that's not the worst part. When attacks hit the city, fake footage put Ken at the center of them.
